description: Get the EIP-712 OrderCancellations typed data to cancel a CoW limit order off-chain (gasless). The owner signs it; POST {chainId, orderUids:[uid], signature} to /limit/cancel on the SwapChan API. Never signs. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

chainId.description: Chain id where CoW runs: 1 Ethereum, 8453 Base, 42161 Arbitrum, 137 Polygon, 56 BNB, 43114 Avalanche, 59144 Linea
